scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,agent,frontend -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "python3 agent/main.py" "cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,agent,frontend -c cyan,magenta,green "node backend/dist/index.js" "python3 agent/main.py" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix electron && cd agent && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.electron:dev: npm run dev & sleep 8 && npm run dev --prefix electron
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run dist --prefix electron
scripts.electron:dist:win: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run dist:win --prefix electron
scripts.electron:dist:mac: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run dist:mac --prefix electron
